summary.text: Chandra Dillard is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 23, having assumed office in 2008, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as director of community relations at Furman University, and notes that the Democratic primary for her seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Dillard earned a B.S. from Winthrop College and an M.P.A. from Walden University, according to Ballotpedia.
She is the Director of Community Relations at Furman University and served on the Greenville City Council from 1999 to 2008.
Dillard has been assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee in the 2021-2022, 2023-2024 and 2025-2026 sessions.
